rules.statement: Where a building has been erected not wholly on the ground of another, but is built partly on one's own ground and only encroaches partially on the ground of another, the Court may, where it is equitable to do so, order the owner of the ground encroached upon to transfer that portion on reasonable terms to the party who made the encroachment.
rules.supporting_quote: "The Court may, according to the circumstances, after it is satisfied that there has been an encroachment, either order the removal of it, or, according to the authority quoted to us by the defendant's counsel, order the defendant to buy that part of the plaintiff's land on which he has encroached."
